Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/08/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 18 as introduced exempts the Floyd Cherokee Medical Center LLC from paying Utility Gross Receipts Tax, which will decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund by approximately $21,000 per year.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education

Committee: Finance and Taxation Education
Sponsor: Jones
Analyst: Jessica Perez
Date: 03/10/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 18 as introduced exempts the Floyd Cherokee Medical Center LLC from paying Utility Gross Receipts Tax, which will decrease receipts to the Education Trust Fund by approximately $21,000 per year.
As amended and reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation Education, the provisions of this bill would sunset on September 30, 2025.
Arthur Orr, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation Education
